Asset type: a single transparent marginal illustration for a medieval manuscript fantasy journal.
Art direction: Imagine a medieval monk copying the adventure description and amusing himself by adding a small, observant, slightly mischievous drawing in the margin. Medieval marginalia, naive but confident pen drawing, gently exaggerated proportions, uneven hand-drawn contours, flat sparse gouache washes. Warm ochre/gold ink contours with fine dark-brown inner marks, ivory bone or fabric where appropriate, small deep lapis-blue and brick-red touches. The subject itself carries the character and humor.
This is a recognizable story illustration, not an ornamental foliate element. No vines, interlace, filigree, acanthus, frames, heraldic badge, metallic relief, rich rendering, decorative border, scrollwork, or filler foliage. No photorealism, gradients, dramatic lighting, cast shadows, glow, halo, labels, letters, words, numbers, captions, watermark, page background or rectangular panel.
TRUE ALPHA transparency outside the drawn subject and inside open spaces. No opaque white or dark backdrop. Complete illustration with a small transparent safety margin. Clear readable shapes at small journal scale.

Subject: One broken obsidian shard leaking a thin vermilion lava seam beside a village water bucket and tiny spilled blue water trail. A concrete fire-and-water detail.
Composition: Small compact object or clue drawing, roughly square occupied-art silhouette, recognizable material and simple shapes; only the story objects described, no filler ornament or botanical flourish.
Input images: The input image is a STYLE REFERENCE for hand-made ink lines and restrained manuscript colors only. Create only the specified story object.
